id_capture_policy.rule: Each ESPN gameId below was captured from that game's OWN ESPN URL, surfaced by a dedicated per-game search. No id was derived, incremented or decremented from any other id.
id_capture_policy.p0_reference: 2026-08-27 P0: results joined on team names without a game id; a later archive-verification found one of two INFERRED ids was wrong (AZ@SF 825038 -> 823179).
id_capture_policy.why_inference_would_have_failed_here: The captured ids are NOT ordered by kickoff time and do NOT occupy one contiguous block. Within the 4018733xx block the mapping is 301=CIN@PHI(8:00pm), 302=WSH@BAL(6:00pm), 303=NYG@NYJ(7:30pm), 304=ATL@MIA(7:00pm), 305=SEA@KC(8:00pm), 306=TB@JAX(7:30pm), 307=HOU@CAR(7:00pm) — sorting by kickoff and assigning sequentially would have mis-assigned EVERY row. Three further games sit entirely outside that block (401873614, 401874048, 401874102), and the 2026 REG week-1 ids (4018726xx/401872925) interleave below them.
id_capture_policy.binding_status: IDENTIFIED, NOT BOUND. Search snippets identify and never bind. These ids are retained here so a future result-binding pass has a real key to archive-verify against, exactly as the 8/27 MLB artifact retained real gamePks.
